text_blocks.snippet: The largest planet in our solar system is Jupiter.

list.snippet: Size: It is about 11 times wider than Earth and can hold more than 1,300 Earths inside it.
Mass: It weighs more than twice as much as all the other planets in the solar system combined.
Composition: It is a gas giant made mostly of hydrogen and helium, meaning it has no solid surface.
Great Red Spot: This is a giant storm on the planet that is bigger than Earth and has raged for hundreds of years.
Moons: It has dozens of moons, including Ganymede, which is the largest moon in the solar system.
